title: Decision Center
empty_all: Items explicitly decided in meetings are gathered here automatically; you can also ask the AI chat to extract decisions from any meeting.
empty_filtered: No decisions match the current filters
add_text_placeholder: Decision text (type /today then space to insert a date)
add_text_too_long: Decision text must be at most 2000 characters
sm_hint: "Active" and "Done" are built-in and cannot be renamed or deleted; other statuses are fully editable. A status marked "Counts as done" is hidden in the default view and sinks to the bottom.
sm_closing_hint: When checked, decisions in this status are hidden by default and collapsed at the bottom
sm_anchor_locked: Built-in status: cannot be renamed or deleted
sm_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? Its decisions will fall back to "Active".
sm_deleted_reassigned: Deleted "{name}"; {count} decision(s) fell back to Active
add_flow_hint: Entries join the selected meeting's decision flow and stay editable here or in the meeting minutes.
topic_view_hint: Topic view merges the same decision across meetings into a main record; earlier entries fold into an evolution chain.
evo_mark_superseded: Mark as superseded by the latest decision in this topic (leaves the to-do list)
evo_mark_ok: Marked as superseded; the old decision left the to-do list
evo_undo_ok: Supersede reverted; the decision is restored to its prior status
meeting_evo_badge_main: Discussed across {count} meetings · view topic timeline
meeting_evo_badge_history: This topic advanced in another meeting
meeting_evo_from_banner: From Decision Center · viewing the evolution of "{title}"
